summary: Underwood's campaign site states he supports sponsoring Palestinian families 'fleeing the ongoing genocide in Gaza' and will 'condemn the atrocities happening in Gaza' as Governor.
quote: I support Colorado families who want to sponsor Palestinian families fleeing the ongoing genocide in Gaza. I believe in human rights and civil rights for all, and as Governor, I will condemn the atrocities happening in Gaza.

summary: Underwood's campaign site demands AIPAC register as a foreign agent under FARA, calling it a foreign government influence and citing $127M spent across 389 races in 2024.
quote: No Foreign Government Should Own an American Election. The Foreign Agents Registration Act has been the law since 1938. It is time to enforce it — starting with AIPAC.
